lines.text: Unlocks: After The Citizens chat 4. It was so late in the evening that

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Everyone, make sure you visit the Day and Night pub in the Ark.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It's out of this world.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Did you go there for a drink?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: No, I haven't had a drop.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I came out to buy a few things,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: when suddenly these ladies dressed up in freaky costumes popped out.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: They kept trying to convince me to go into the store,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: so even though I had some reservations,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I decided to head in

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: and get into the Halloween spirit.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: And let me tell you, it was fantastic!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: How so?
Was it the costumes that were amazing?
Was it that the drinks tasted amazing?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: That's right!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: See, you're the only one who gets me. Not these other chumps.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: First them, now you, Commander?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I told you, I'm the furthest thing from a heavy drinker you can imagine.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Everyone in the bar is all dressed up:

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: the servers, the cooks, everyone.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: And they've gone all out with the costumes too.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You should see how detailed they are.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: And don't get me started on their bodies.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I knew it.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: You're just salivating over their bodies.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You make it sound so crude.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Isn't this a major draw for Halloween?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You get to reveal a side of yourself

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: that you don't usually have the opportunity to flaunt.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Halloween costumes are the perfect avenue for that.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Ah-hah!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Is that why you were going on about

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: wanting to be a sexy witch before?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Sometimes it feels like

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: you all are out to get me...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Anyway, if any of you are interested, you better hurry.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: This place will just be a regular pub after Halloween.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I'm not sure if I can go,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: but thanks for the info.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: No problem!
